title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E11 — Al Green
Highlights feature guest Al Green singing "Let's Stay Together" and author Verta Mae Grosvenor reading form her latest book, Thursdays and Every Other Sunday Off.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E21 — Almost Home
Webster's Uncle Jack has Webster visit him. Uncle Jack runs a foster home with a woman, but a conflict may force him to quit the home.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E22 — Farewell to Arms
Webster asks permission to buy a BB gun and he resorts to responsibility to get one. After getting one, and practicing with his friends, he accidentally kills a bird. This bird has babies and he takes the responsibility of raising them on his own.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E27 — My Family's Honor
Webster and Katherine both end up cheating on some school-related projects at the same time.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E29 — Rear View Mirror (Part 2)
As they continue to reminisce, Webster, Papa Papadapolis, and Jerry receive news that George and Katherine have both survived the hurricane.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E1 — The Landlords
George and Katherine, who bought Bill & Cassie's house, have a three-ring circus with the clown they found to rent the downstairs apartment.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E22 — Guardian Angel
The spirit of Ray's late wife returns to help Tamera make a tough decision, and Ray to get on with his life.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E1 — Designer Genes
Tia and Tamera slip backstage at a red-hot fashion show.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E2 — A Separate Peace
Fed up with sharing the same bedroom, the twins are torn between getting their own rooms.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E3 — Working Girls
Ray's budding relationship with a new woman leaves Tamera feeling jealous.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E4 — Show Me the Money
When Tamera learns that Tia is being paid less than a male co-worker, she poses as Tia.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E7 — The Nutty Moesha
It’s Halloween and Moesha’s acting crazy, Niecy’s growing body hair, and Dorian’s dogsitting a ferocious bulldog.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E8 — The Candidate
A woman city council candidate loses Moesha’s support when she gets the hots for Hakeem.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E9 — Definitely Not The Cosbys
When Moesha tells her dad she’s engaged, he fantasizes about solving his family problems like Bill Cosby.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E10 — All This & Turkey Too
Q comes home for Thanksgiving and asks Moesha for his ring back.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E11 — The Player
Moesha’s attempt to solve Niecy’s 'ain’t gotta man blues' backfires.

S2 E10 — Temptations
When Mary (Marla Gibbs) accepts the 'glamorous' title of Chairwoman of the Church benefit variety show, she soon realizes it's really a dirty job and prays for a group like the 'Temptations' to save the show.

S2 E11 — Father's Day
A surprise visit by his Air Force dad prompts Calvin to bid farewell to the family in exchange for a new life abroad with his father.

S2 E12 — Matchmakers
In efforts to find Rose a permanent mate, Mary and Sandra resort to a video dating service that transforms Rose into a Tina Turner look-a-like which eventually leads to an embarrassing and hilarious outcome when she meets her match.

S2 E13 — Check Snub
When Pearl (Helen Martin) is refused her social security check because the computer lists her as deceased, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Rose (Alaina Reed) and Sandra (Jackée), join in the battle against bureaucracy, only to land themselves in jail.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E6 — Little Sister
Eddie is determined to keep Malcolm away from his younger sister.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E7 — Big Brother Is Watching
Eddie agrees to spend time with a ten-year-old boy in order to date a beautiful woman.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E8 — The Boy Who Cried Werewolf
Eddie fears a family curse will make him a werewolf on Halloween.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E9 — Dead Guy
After faking an injury in order to sue Malcolm and Eddie, an unruly customer suddenly dies in the kitchen.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E10 — Do The KC Hustle
An old college rival shows up at the bar looking to avenge a game of pool he lost to Malcolm.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.
